title: Joining a friend
summary: Connect to your host's Realm of Thrones server.

sections.heading: Pick how to join
steps: Direct is the host's IP address and UDP port 4200.
Steam lobby only works if the host turned on Steam. Use the host's Steam profile name, with Steam running on both PCs.
Type the password if the host gave you one. Leave it empty when the server has no password.

sections.heading: Connect
steps: Pick the same setup as the host.
Click Connect while Bannerlord is closed.
Keep the launcher open while you play.
When Bannerlord closes, close the launcher. It takes its Coop out and puts yours back.

sections.heading: The first join
steps: The first join after you install or change mods can take several minutes while the game prepares the map and compiles shaders. Do not close the game.
The game can look frozen. Wait for it.

sections.heading: Story choices
steps: Realm of Thrones asks questions during its story, like the sieges. Every player sees them with a timer.
The first player to answer decides for everyone. If nobody answers in 60 seconds, the default goes ahead.

sections.heading: The host's settings
steps: On the server you use the host's MCM settings, so every PC runs the mods the same way. Your own files are never changed.
Realm of Thrones' music and markers keep your own choice.
